factual_errors.text: Deindustrialisation: decline of coal, steel, shipbuilding, textiles; resources ran out, machines replaced workers
factual_errors.correction: UK coal did not run out. Large reserves were left unmined because deep mining became uneconomic compared with cheaper imported coal, and pits were closed. Some iron ore deposits were worked out or became too low-grade to use. The bullet should say that resources became too costly to extract or were cheaper to import, not that they ran out. keyPoints[0].content ("Coal and iron ore ran out or became costly to dig") is closer to correct, but still suggests coal ran out.
